question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **PERNICIOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Malicious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"pernicious"** means something that is harmful, damaging, or destructive, often in a subtle or gradual way. (हानिकारक)
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking has a pernicious effect on health, often leading to serious diseases over time.
 
 
• The word **"malicious"** refers to someone or something that intends to do harm, either physically or emotionally. (दुर्भावनापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The malicious rumors spread by her rivals damaged her reputation.
